Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Scientists studied largemouth bass populations in several different geographic locations. They recorded information about the size, number, and weight of fish in each population. Which of the following will be best suited for recording these data?
A. a map
B. a diagram
C. a chart
D. a graph
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
